touch_contract.hold: A future candle reaches one touch-time prior ATR beyond the expected-side near boundary before a completed close is more than0.25ATR through the far boundary.
touch_contract.touch_bar: No favorable excursion from the touch candle is credited. A close-through at that decision close is an immediate break.
touch_contract.same_future_bar: Hold wins when favorable excursion and opposite close-through occur in the same future candle: the opposite closing price necessarily follows the favorable intrabar extreme. This is not execution stop/target priority.
touch_contract.censoring: Primary outcomes require the full50 future completed candles inside the evaluation window, even when a partial path resolved early. Partial observed outcomes remain separately recorded. Complete but undecided paths are unresolved.
touch_contract.rate_denominator: Primary hold fraction uses every full-horizon touch, including unresolved outcomes. Resolved-only hold rate is separately labeled.

shift_contract.seed_policy: SHA-256 keyed by seed,feature identity,replica and attempt; no outcome input.
shift_contract.lifetime: Same birth and scheduled expiry; parallel geometry updates. Each real/random feature has its own visits and close invalidation. Never copy real touch times. Later real features do not retroactively redraw an earlier shift.
shift_contract.matched_cohort: A feature enters real-versus-random summaries only when every requested shifted replica is valid at birth. Full real observations and unshiftable reasons remain recorded.
shift_contract.birth_invalidation: Each geometry already beyond the close-invalidation boundary at its birth is inactive forever; recovery cannot reopen it.

bootstrap: 2000 resamples of whole touch/event sessions, using the same session draws for real/control, including eligible sessions with no events. Difference is real event-weighted mean minus pooled random event-weighted mean. If any draw has a zero denominator, no nominal95% interval is claimed; show valid-draw counts. At least two distinct eligible sessions are required before attempting resampling.
